ash: Quick question — how should we surface 'rollforward' of cache credits in the cost dashboard when a model variant rollout changes cache behavior? Tenant saw a big negative saving after the canary.
maria: Yeah that happened yesterday. When we swapped model:maven@v1 -> model:maven@v2 the prefetch credits didn't carry and the dashboard shows a drop. :facepalm:
chris: Are we sure it's a display-only problem and not attribution pipeline? Credits are keyed by model SKU + fingerprint. If SKU changes, the old credits look like a different entity.
tamika: Two options: (A) show a rollforward mapping line that maps old SKU -> new SKU using rollout metadata; or (B) annotate tenant card with an amortized "transferred credits" footnote.
ash: +1 for (A) — more explicit. Backend needs a mapping from rollout_id -> sku pairs. Who owns emitting that? @chris?
chris: We already emit rollout events to telemetry, but econ export doesn't include SKU mapping. I can add a small rollout payload to the econ stream: 
```json
{"rollout_id":"r-20240401-01","from_sku":"maven-v1","to_sku":"maven-v2","ts":1712549800}
```
That will let consumers join on rollout_id.
ash: Nice. With that the console can draw a dotted connector from v1 savings -> v2 labeled "rolled forward credits".
maria: UX question: should rolled credits be additive or should we replace the original slab? PM suggests conservative additive (show both) and let ops reconcile.
tamika: Additive is safest for billing but possibly confusing. My proposal: default to additive, with tooltip "credits amortized over 24h" and a small toggle to collapse into a single rolled value.
chris: Implementation note: econ export will accept an API flag `include_rollforwards=true` and the stream will materialize rollforward rows. Example endpoint: `GET /internal/econ/stream?start=1712540000&end=1712550000&include_rollforwards=true`. We'll precompute daily rollforward maps to avoid expensive joins.
nash: Any perf or storage concerns for the econ index?
chris: We'll store rollforward as lightweight metadata in the daily table (rollforwards: date -> list of pairs). Join will be a lookup, not a full join. Should be fine.
maria: For UI we need: toggle on cost card "Show rollforward credits" default off, tooltip copy, and a subtle arrow glyph for the connector. I'll mock.
tamika: And an alerting rule: if post-rollout tenant net savings delta < -20% within 2h, fire an ops alert so PM/SRE can triage. Put it in the econ-slo rules channel.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-meta payload PR merged to #pulls — tests green. :rocket:
nash: Action items: @chris add rollout payload + api flag; @maria mock UI + tooltip; @tamika add alert rule; I will update docs and billing note.
maria: Will post mock by EOD tomorrow and link here.
chris: Opening backend PR now, estimate ~2d work including tests.
nash: Thanks all.
